title: Manage a conflict of interest
summary: When an employee, director, founder or adviser has a personal interest in a company decision. A confidential disclosure and management plan with an independent decision and review owner.
outcomes: A confidential disclosure and management plan with an independent decision and review owner.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When an employee, director, founder or adviser has a personal interest in a company decision.

parts.title: Record the interest and affected decisions
parts.guidance: Collect the relationship, economic interest, transaction and relevant roles in a restricted file. Separate factual disclosures from allegations and identify decisions that should pause pending review.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Determine the applicable governance process
parts.guidance: Ask counsel or the designated independent reviewer to check the policy, governing documents and local requirements. Select reviewers who are not deciding their own conflict.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Prepare alternatives and mitigation options
parts.guidance: Document options such as recusal, independent pricing, information barriers or declining the transaction. Identify who can implement each measure and what evidence would show it is working.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve the conflict-management decision
parts.guidance: The authorized independent decision makers approve or reject the proposal under the applicable process. Record participants, disclosures, recusals and reasons while restricting sensitive personal information.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Track implementation and subsequent changes
parts.guidance: Confirm access restrictions and other measures with their owners. Calendar a review and reopen the decision when the interest, transaction or responsible role changes.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A confidential disclosure and management plan with an independent decision and review owner.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
